cautionsNotes.item: Follow all standard XXX safety practices.
The system is to be serviced by authorised personnel only.
Make sure that all switches are on default position before switching ON the incoming supply.
Prior to switching ON the system, make sure that input supply voltage is of specified value.
Make sure that control wires in panels are secured firmly.
Never plug/ unplug connectors, modules while system is ON.
In humid condition switch ON the Panel Space Heater before switching ON panels.
